verdict.rationale: Unreal offers 'access to the source code' but only as source-available under Epic's proprietary EULA (revenue-share terms, GitHub account linkage required), not under an OSI-style open license; probe evidence confirms the GitHub source repo is account/EULA-gated (api.github.com returns 404 keylessly) rather than freely licensed. No evidence of any open-license (MIT/Apache/GPL) distribution of the engine source.
